how_to_steps: Put your Gemini API key in gemini-key.txt inside the project folder
Prompt Claude: 'In this folder, read my Gemini API key from gemini-key.txt and never show it on screen. Ask the Gemini model for 4 images at once, in 16:9, from this ...' (caption truncated)
Reuse the same connection for citations (Gemini checks claims), video understanding (Gemini watches full videos), and app artwork

relevance.why: Practical multi-model pattern for a Claude Code user: keep Claude as the orchestrator, call Gemini for what Claude lacks (native image generation, long-video understanding). Useful for app assets, marketing thumbnails, and content pipelines.

implement_score.why: Small script/skill: Claude Code reads a key file (better: env var), calls Gemini image API for N 16:9 images, saves to assets/. Could be packaged as a reusable skill ('gemini-images', 'gemini-video-notes'). Cost is Gemini API usage only. Avoid key-in-txt-file; use .env and gitignore.
